question: Chapter 943... IT'S SO TOUCHING!!! (BENG!!) Izou?! The commander of the 16th division of Whitebeard Pirates, Izou, was one of the Nine Red Scabbards? Ahhh... Was Kouzuki Oden the commander of the 16th division?! Land
answer: Oh... You guys noticed another small detail. Young Kin'emon and the others in the flashback scene, if you count them no doubt there're 9 people, but what is this? Thought it was O-Kiku... but the person feels a little different... By the way, Izou is one of the commanders that appeared in the Summit War arc. It's true that they look similar since Izou also wore a kimono. And in volume 82 chapter 820, it did said that some people from Wano Country joined Whitebeard's ship~. One day the answer to this question will be revealed, so just continue reading. You'll notice it, right~!
name: 420 Land
